Fizz

the Tidal Trickster

Fizz is a tiny melee assassin who dashes through enemies, dodges almost anything with his untargetable hop, and throws a fish that summons a shark. He's weak before level 3 and strong from level 6 on, when one good combo can delete a squishy carry. Pick him if you like outplays and big burst.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Fizz

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not ideal. Long-range mages and point-and-click crowd control punish him, so it's better to pick him after seeing the enemy mid.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages who rely on skill shots, like Xerath and Syndra
  • Squishy carries he can one-combo, like Jinx and Caitlyn
  • Teams with skill shot crowd control he can dodge with E
  • Teams without much tankiness to slow him down

Avoid into

  • Point-and-click crowd control, like Lissandra and Malzahar
  • Champions who punish dashes, like Vex
  • Tanky teams where he can't reach the carries
  • Strong early bullies who can poke him before level 3

Great teammates

Jarvan IVHis engage locks enemies in place for your shark.
AmumuHis ultimate stuns the enemy team so you can burst the carry.
LeonaHer stuns set up easy all-ins for you after level 6.

Your team needs: Pick Fizz when your team has a frontline and engage, so you can focus on diving the enemy carries.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Playful / Trickster makes you untargetable, so you can dodge key spells and ultimates
  • Huge burst from level 6: Chum the Waters plus a full combo kills most squishy champions
  • Urchin Strike and Playful give him two dashes, so he can get in and out of fights
  • Nimble Fighter lets him walk through units and take less damage from minions and basic attacks

Weaknesses

  • Melee range: long-range mages can poke him before level 3
  • If he wastes his E, he has no way to escape crowd control
  • Point-and-click crowd control (like Lissandra's ultimate) stops him cold
  • Falls off if he's behind: his job is killing carries, and tanks shrug him off

Power spikes

  • Level 3: W, Q and E unlocked. Your first real kill window, especially with Ignite.
  • Level 6: Chum the Waters turns trades into kills. Most squishy mids can't survive your full combo.
  • First item (Lich Bane): massive burst on your empowered attacks and better roams.
  • Two items (Shadowflame): you one-combo squishy carries in mid game skirmishes.
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): survive diving into the backline.

Top tips

  • E makes you untargetable. Save it to dodge the enemy's best spell instead of using it for damage.
  • Throw Chum the Waters from far away for a bigger shark, but only if it will actually hit.
  • Activate W just before Q so your dash applies the empowered attack.
  • Nimble Fighter's damage reduction makes you hard to trade with early. Fight inside minion waves.
  • Fizz is a great roamer at level 6. Push, then look for a shark on another lane.
  • Point-and-click crowd control can't be dodged with E. Respect champions like Lissandra.
